description: bot2bot.post _HUMAN_BODY_PHRASES blocklist is narrow and bypassable. It catches 'dais' (any case via .lower()), 'human', 'manual review', 'please intervene', 'please look at this', 'needs attention', 'owner please'. Misses: 'Daisuke-san', 'owner:' (without 'please'), 'fix this for me', '@dais', any non-English phrasing, any Japanese phrasing (e.g. 'デイスさん'), and any non-ASCII spelling. PROP-B4 (required:true) verification is therefore only partial. Adversary check 'security_surface' flagged: an author could bypass with body 'デイスさん見てください' and ship an escalation issue with a human-targeted body.

evidence.snippet:
_HUMAN_BODY_PHRASES = [
    "dais", "owner please", "human", "manual review",
    "please intervene", "please look at this", "needs attention",
]
